lanes.label: Fast pull-request checks
lanes.purpose: Deterministic code checks with no field-evidence dependency.

lanes.label: Affected-domain regression
lanes.purpose: Behavioral checks selected from changed paths; unknown paths fail wide.

lanes.label: Full nightly
lanes.purpose: Broad behavioral, migration, offline, performance, and build coverage.

lanes.label: Provider contract scheduled
lanes.purpose: Provider adapter and shadow checks with external evidence kept explicit.

lanes.label: Release candidate
lanes.purpose: Code, export, policy, and evidence gates. Blocked evidence fails promotion.

lanes.label: Manual hardware and device evidence
lanes.purpose: Validates manifests but never substitutes for real hardware execution.

checks.notes: Validates conservative planned-versus-executed coverage evaluation; wildcard registration never satisfies product scenarios.
Validates approved timing baselines, robust thresholds, package identity isolation, and release fail-closed behavior.
Static source guard; not runtime behavior evidence.
Exercises commit, migration, suite, and workflow-result binding without substituting for real pgTAP execution.
Rejects direct workflow input interpolation and validates repository-bound artifact paths.
Checks workflow wiring only; pgTAP execution is a separate workflow check.
Runs against local Supabase in CI; no production backend claim.
Evaluates the authoritative external-evidence registry; declarations alone never resolve requirements.
Reports visibility state; does not grant production approval.
